help_text:
owa-graph contacts - Personal contacts (list, find, create, delete)

Shortcuts:
  list    List my contacts
  find    Search contacts
  create  Create contact (--name [--email])
  delete  Delete --id

Common flags accepted by every shortcut:
  --pretty   Human-readable output (table for known shapes, indented JSON otherwise)
  --ndjson   Stream collection items one JSON object per line
  --retry    Honor Retry-After once on 429/503
